newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hyundai, Zim Navigation in slot exchange accord.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai, Zim Navigation in slot exchange accord.

text.p: Zim Israel Navigation Co said on Sunday it has reached a slot exchange agreement with Hyundai Merchant Marine Co regarding Hyundai's transpacific services and Zim's East Coast of North America service.
Cooperation will start in the second half of June depending on approval from governmental authorities.
Hyundai operates three weekly services from Asia to the West Coast of North America and Zim operates a weekly service between Asia and the East Coast.
Zim Israel is one of the largest container shipping companies in the world. It is owned by the Israeli government and Israel Corp.
